# Create small-scale technology certificates

Based on Clean Energy Regulator material licensed under a Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0 licence. Retrieved 2026-09-01. Headings and wording have been
abridged for this test fixture. No logo, Coat of Arms or identified third-party
material is included.

## 1. Before creating STCs

Certificates must be created in the REC Registry within 12 months of the
installation date. Before creating certificates, check that the system is eligible,
confirm the right to create the certificates, use the correct REC Registry account
type, and ensure all required evidence is complete and signed.

## 2. Required documents

The required documents depend on the system. They can include a system owner
statutory declaration, a system size statutory declaration, invoices, rates notices
and contract information. Documents must be complete and accurate before the claim
is created.

## 3. Approved product lists

Claims for small generation units use the current approved PV module, inverter and
solar battery lists. The lists are dynamic; eligibility must be checked against the
current list when the claim is prepared.
